name: teachme-showme
description: Skills that turn a request into one self-contained HTML file: TeachMe builds a short course that makes you understand, fast, ShowMe builds a deck you present from.

plugins.name: teachme
plugins.description: Teach a subject fast as one self-contained HTML course — short chapters that each teach one idea through a concrete worked example, with diagrams, optional quick checks, progress tracking, search and offline reading. Use when someone wants to understand something rather than get a one-line answer, or to turn slides, documents or a codebase into study material. Run /teachme for the full build (planner, parallel agents, reviewer) or /teachme-quick for a fast single-session build.

plugins.name: showme
plugins.description: Build a presentation as one self-contained HTML deck — fullscreen slides, progressive builds, speaker notes with a timer, overview grid, read mode and print-to-PDF, in a theme chosen to match the look you describe. Use whenever someone has to present to an audience, or wants a document, report or project turned into slides. Run /showme for the full build (planner, parallel agents, reviewer) or /showme-quick for a fast single-session build.
